title: Linear Search
definition: Linear Search checks each value from left to right until the target is found or the list ends.
realLifeExample: Looking for your name in an attendance sheet line by line is a real-life linear search.

algorithm.Iterative:
(Linear Search) LINEAR(DATA, N, ITEM, LOC)

1. Set DATA[N + 1] := ITEM.
2. Set LOC := 1.
3. Repeat while DATA[LOC] != ITEM: set LOC := LOC + 1.
4. If LOC = N + 1, then set LOC := 0.
5. Exit.
algorithm.Functions:
FUNCTION LINEAR(DATA, N, ITEM)

1. Set DATA[N + 1] := ITEM.
2. Set LOC := 1.
3. Repeat while DATA[LOC] != ITEM: set LOC := LOC + 1.
4. If LOC = N + 1, return 0; else return LOC.

MAIN:
1. Read N, DATA, ITEM.
2. LOC := LINEAR(DATA, N, ITEM).
3. Print LOC.
algorithm.Recursion:
FUNCTION LINEAR(DATA, N, ITEM, LOC)

1. If DATA[LOC] = ITEM, then:
   If LOC = N + 1, return 0; else return LOC.
2. Else call LINEAR(DATA, N, ITEM, LOC + 1).
